dropped.what: 1 more files of the new code that call the changed functions

experiments.why: A T-shirt must still be keyed on its own subcategory as t-shirts / T-Shirts.
A multi-word subcategory with an ampersand should slug to its own key rather than a shared bucket.
A null product must fall into the uncategorised group.
The real 'Clothing - Uncategorized' subcategory that holds 45% of stranded stock must map to the uncategorised key.
The central-only T-shirt card must carry group t-shirts and groupLabel T-Shirts.
With no stranded cards the row must be exactly the single Sneakers chip.
Mixed watches, t-shirts and tracksuits cards must give one chip per type in taxonomy order, then Sneakers.
Three bags cards must give exactly the bags and sneakers chips and nothing for empty types.
